item.description:
Breathe sounds much gentler. The sound is rebuilt on the recipe from the research: a soft bed of pink noise with the low pulse sitting inside it, held steady — no more bare tones. And clicking Breathe without headphones now says so on the button itself, instead of appearing to do nothing.

The Accounting pack now knows the software an accountancy practice names all day — QuickBooks Online, Sage 50, KashFlow, FreshBooks, BrightPay, Taxfiler and friends — and when you say Xero and the machine writes "0", it's corrected.
